about: Who may sponsor a work visa, researched November 14, 2026, for the eight countries whose permits are researched (terms.json). Elsewhere the game takes it that an employer sponsors, as most work visas ask, and says so. In the game an employer is an outside job offered or taken there, or a project of yours being made there (through the production's local company); an agent is your agent.

US.basis: An O-1 is petitioned for by a U.S. employer or a U.S. agent; an artist can't petition for themselves.

source.what: USCIS, O-1 Visa: Individuals with Extraordinary Ability or Achievement (petitioner: a U.S. employer or a U.S. agent)

GB.basis: A Creative Worker visa needs a certificate of sponsorship from a licensed UK sponsor for the work.

source.what: GOV.UK, Creative Worker visa: you need a certificate of sponsorship from a licensed sponsor

CA.basis: An employer-specific work permit names the Canadian employer the work is for.

source.what: IRCC, Work permits: an employer-specific work permit names the employer

AU.basis: The 408 visa's Entertainment Activities stream needs an approved sponsor for the engagement.

source.what: Department of Home Affairs, Temporary Activity visa (subclass 408), Entertainment Activities stream: a sponsor is needed

NZ.basis: The Entertainers Work Visa is for an engagement with a New Zealand sponsor or employer.

source.what: Immigration New Zealand, Entertainers Work Visa

IE.basis: Atypical Working Scheme permission is for work with an Irish employer, who supports the application.

source.what: Irish Immigration Service Delivery, Employment visa (Atypical Working Scheme)

FR.basis: The carte talent for artistic work asks for a contract with a French employer or organiser.

source.what: Démarches Étrangers, the carte talent – profession artistique et culturelle procedure

DE.basis: A residence permit for employment in culture and entertainment needs a concrete job offer from a German employer.

source.what: German Consulate General Hong Kong, national visa for employment: the employment contract or job offer
